text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Council of Europe Secretary General Daniel Tarschys in Macedonia to promote the Council's information centre in Skopje. Tarschys met on Sunday with foreign minister Ljubomir Frckoski, due to be received by president Kiro Gligorov on Monday.

- An unidentified flying object glimmering in the sky some 300-400 meters high spotted over Skopje on Saturday evening. The UFO hovered over the city some 20 minutes before flying off in south-west direction.

- Court proceedings against those involved in the TAT savings society financial scandal could begin around Orthodox Easter. Several judges to preside over the trial, the defence team will include more than ten lawyers. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +381 11 222 4305
